verdicts.reason: Both share the same reading-order fault: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the subhead and the 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' legal line, so the fine print now comes before the hook, and in both the headline runs over the decorative circle. A also has a squeezed one-line '20% off' headline that runs almost edge to edge, and a large dead gap above and below the small product before the CTA. B's stacked '20% / off' gives a stronger, better-sized focal point for the tall format and less dead space. Its flaws are that 'case.' sits alone on its own line and the can is shrunk even further, which weakens the product.
